description: §6.8 g-assignment-emits-init-set-inverting-reset (RT): a no-`default=` cell `<ticks> = 0` with a TOP-LEVEL reassignment `@ticks = @ticks + 1` (module-init drives ticks 0->1). reset(@ticks) must re-evaluate the DECLARED init (0), not the reassignment expression. Pre-fix the reassignment clobbered the decl's init-thunk last-write-wins, so reset re-ran `@ticks + 1` and INCREMENTED to 2; the fix restores 0.
rationale: §6.8.1: when `default=` is absent, reset(@cell) re-evaluates the cell's INIT expression. A reassignment is not a re-declaration, so it must not register an init-thunk; reset restores the declared initial (0), never the assignment's `current + 1`.
